description.en: Markdown themes for DeepSeek Harness: a theme chip beside the composer picks one of 69 themes (12 ColaMD built-ins) shown as sample cards, .md files render in place in the document preview under the selected theme, and documents or slide decks export to A4 PDF, Word, 16:9 slide PDF or PPTX with the same CSS the screen uses. Slide mode follows ColaMD-extend's own slides.css and 11 layouts (cover, section, agenda, kpi, timeline, steps, matrix, two-col, figure, quote, closing) with page directives, page-by-page flow, a fullscreen presenter and per-theme layout colouring.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Markdown 主题工具：输入框旁的主题胶囊以样例卡片展示 69 套主题（含 12 套 ColaMD 内置），.md 在文档预览里按所选主题就地渲染，文稿与幻灯片可导出为 A4 PDF、Word、16:9 幻灯片 PDF 或 PPTX，且与屏幕使用同一份 CSS。幻灯片模式沿用 ColaMD-extend 的 slides.css 与 11 种版式（cover、section、agenda、kpi、timeline、steps、matrix、two-col、figure、quote、closing），支持页头指令、逐页流动、全屏演示与主题自带的分版式配色。
